2  SHRI MOHAN SAUSARKAR - ADVOCATE FOR RESPONDENT NO.5

This petition coming on for admission this d  Ravi Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 ORDER
The case of the petitioner is that the land of the petitioner was acquired under the National Highways Act, 1956.
That no compensation has been paid.

Therefore, the instant petition was filed seeking for an order to restrain the respondents from dispossessing the petitioner till completion of acquisition proceedings in pursuance to the notification dated 7.4.2016.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.5 submits that pursuant to the acquisition an award has been passed on 13.4.2017 and the acquisition proceedings are completed.
It is for the petitioner to take recourse in law so far as the awarded amount is concerned.
In view of the contentions advanced, we do not find any ground to keep this matter pending.
The plea of the petitioner is that acquisition proceedings have not taken place.
However, the learned counsel for the respondents submits that not only the acquisition proceedings are concluded but even the award has also been determined.
Hence, we find no good ground to proceed further.
Hence, the petition is dismissed.

(RAVI MALIMATH) 
 CHIEF JUSTICE
